name: Banseiki 1534 leader portraits: 22 art mappings at game start

steps.code: BuildHeadlessGameSetup(); g_GameParameters:FullRefresh(); HideGameSetup(); return 'Banseiki HostGame setup refreshed'

local expected={'LEADER_JAC_ODA_NOBUHIDE','LEADER_JAC_DATE_TANEMUNE','LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO','LEADER_JAC_HOJO_UJITSUNA','LEADER_JAC_YAMANOUCHI_UESUGI_NORIMASA','LEADER_JAC_TAKEDA_NOBUTORA','LEADER_JAC_NAGAO_TAMEKAGE','LEADER_JAC_IMAGAWA_UJITERU','LEADER_JAC_MATSUDAIRA_KIYOYASU','LEADER_JAC_ASAKURA_TAKAKAGE','LEADER_JAC_ASHIKAGA_YOSHIHARU','LEADER_JAC_MIYOSHI_NAGAYOSHI','LEADER_JAC_ROKKAKU_SADAYORI','LEADER_JAC_HONGANJI_SHONYO','LEADER_JAC_OUCHI_YOSHITAKA','LEADER_JAC_AMAGO_TSUNEHISA','LEADER_JAC_MORI_MOTONARI','LEADER_JAC_CHOSOKABE_KUNICHIKA','LEADER_JAC_OTOMO_YOSHIAKI','LEADER_JAC_SHIMAZU_TAKAHISA','LEADER_JAC_RYUKYU_SHO_SEI','LEADER_JAC_AINU_TARIKONA'}; local loading={}; local diplo={}; for row in GameInfo.LoadingInfo() do loading[row.LeaderType]=row end; for row in GameInfo.DiplomacyInfo() do diplo[row.Type]=row end; if #PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()~=22 then error('major count is not 22') end; local seen={}; for i,leader in ipairs(expected) do if seen[leader] then error('duplicate expected leader '..leader) end; seen[leader]=true; if PlayerConfigurations[i-1]:GetLeaderTypeName()~=leader then error('leader slot mismatch '..i) end; local fg=leader..'_NEUTRAL'; local bg=leader..'_BACKGROUND'; local db=leader..'_DIPLOMACY_BACKGROUND'; local l=loading[leader]; local d=diplo[leader]; if not l or l.ForegroundImage~=fg or l.BackgroundImage~=bg then error('loading art mismatch '..leader) end; if not d or d.BackgroundImage~=db then error('diplomacy art mismatch '..leader) end end; return '22 leaders with unique loading foregrounds, loading backgrounds, and diplomacy backgrounds'
